conventions: Discrete quarters de-cumulated from YTD 10-Q facts: Q2=H1−Q1, Q3=9M−H1, Q4=FY−9M.
Latest filed vintage per period; later values that only round an earlier precise value keep the precise one.
Growth = fundamental YoY growth (revenue/earnings), never share-price performance; % growth only off a positive base, else absolute change.
gross_profit = revenue − cost_of_revenue as tagged; ebitda_derived = operating income + depreciation (GAAP proxy, not company adjusted EBITDA).
EPS is reported as filed (YTD) — only Q1 EPS is a discrete quarter.
